title: dryopteris heterophlebia
intro: Dryopteris heterophlebia, commonly known as the Autumn fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Dryopteris genus. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress, improve immune function, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris heterophlebia include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
